text: small graphics device writes R plots directly OOXML DrawingML shapes, use openxlsx2::wb_add_drawing(). Cairo, FreeType, fontconfig, xml2 dependency.

title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2

title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2
text: easel_dev() opens device returns file path. Draw R plotting system, call dev.(), hand file openxlsx2::wb_add_drawing().
code: library(easeling) library(openxlsx2)  f <- easel_dev(width = 6, height = 4) plot(1:10, (1:10)^2, type = "b") dev.off()  wb <- wb_workbook()$add_worksheet()$add_drawing(xml = f, dims = "A1")

title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2
code: library(tinyplot)  f <- easel_dev(width = 6, height = 4) plt(mpg ~ wt | factor(cyl), data = mtcars) dev.off()  wb$add_worksheet()$add_drawing(xml = f, dims = "A1")

title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2
code: library(ggplot2)  f <- easel_dev(width = 6, height = 4) print(   ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +     geom_point() +     theme_minimal() ) dev.off()  wb$add_worksheet()$add_drawing(xml = f, dims = "A1")  if (interactive()) wb$open()

title: Open a DrawingML graphics device for openxlsx2 — easel_dev
code: easel_dev(   file = tempfile(fileext = ".xml"),   width = 6,   height = 6,   units = "in",   pointsize = 12,   fontname = "Calibri",   bg = NA,   symbolfamily = "",   underline = FALSE,   strikeout = FALSE,   dims = NULL,   wb = NULL,   sheet = 1,   text_voff = 0.35,   metrics = NULL )

title: Open a DrawingML graphics device for openxlsx2 — easel_dev
text: file Path XML file write. Defaults temp file. plain string instead file, see [easel_xml()]. width, height Device size, `units`. units Unit `width` `height`: `""` (default), `"cm"`, `"mm"` `"px"`. Pixels 96 per inch, value spreadsheet applications use. Ignored `dims` given, since cell region already fixes size. pointsize Default font pointsize. fontname Default font typeface (matches `openxlsx2::wb_add_font()`'s `name` argument), e.g. `"Calibri"`, `"Arial"`. Used whenever R request specific family — .e. whenever plot's `family`/`fontfamily` unset one R's generic aliases (`"sans"`, `"serif"`, `"mono"`, `"symbol"`, `""`). plot sets actual font name (e.g. `par(family = "Georgia")` `theme_minimal(base_family = "Georgia")`), takes priority default. bg Background colour drawn behind plot. default, `NA`, leaves drawing transparent sheet shows . symbolfamily Typeface asked plotmath symbols. glyphs written Unicode either way, matters `fontname` lacks : `"Cambria Math"` usual choice Windows. Empty (default) keeps symbols `fontname`. underline, strikeout Apply underline/strikeout text device. Unlike `fontname`, per-call R equivalent (base graphics underline/strikeout concept), device-wide setting. dims Optionally, cell range `"A1:G15"`. given, `width` `height` ignored computed region via [easel_size()], plot fills region exactly later anchored `dims`. wb, sheet Passed [easel_size()] `dims` given: `openxlsx2` workbook (sheet) read actual column widths row heights . text_voff Vertical text calibration em: text boxes centre-anchored, baseline placed `text_voff` em box centre. default `0.35` calibrated Excel's line layout Calibri; LibreOffice's optimum around 0.24, text sits ~0.1 em low. Increase shift rendered text , decrease shift , spreadsheet application's line layout places visibly ; see `system.file("examples", "calibrate_text.R", package = "easeling")`. metrics Font metrics used text layout (string widths,   vertical centring, margins). `NULL` (default): use real metrics   `fontname` via `systemfonts` package installed,   otherwise built-Calibri-like table. `FALSE`: always use   built-table. list numeric components `widths`,   `ascents`, `descents`, length 95 giving em fractions   ASCII characters 32..126. Metrics affect R computes -   rendering always done spreadsheet application real   font - better metrics mean legend boxes, margins, centring   sized text actually appear. machine writing file need font opened   , `systemfonts` substitutes without saying ; [font_match()]   reports font measured. get real metrics font   machine lacks, install replacement built match (Carlito   Calibri, Liberation Sans Arial, Liberation Serif Times New   Roman), point `systemfonts` actual file   `systemfonts::register_font("Calibri", plain = "calibri.ttf")`   opening device, pass numbers `metrics` .

text: Understood common preset shapes (basic shapes, polygons, stars, block arrows, flowchart symbols, callouts, `donut`, `frame`, `cube`, `can`, `heart`, `cloud`, `wave` ; shadings 3-D lighting reproduced presets list drawn bounding box), shapes without transform (sized anchor), theme style colors, `custGeom` paths made `moveTo`, `lnTo`, `cubicBezTo`, `quadBezTo` `close`, solid, linear radial gradient fills (R >= 4.1 gradients, older versions use first stop color), line properties, shape rotation flips, nested groups, text. Embedded PNG JPEG pictures drawn png jpeg package installed, including cropping, rotation flips. Charts drawn encharter package (openxlsx2) installed. Slicers pivot tables drawn items selected; object, slicer table, placeholder shape stored older readers drawn. Diagrams (SmartArt) drawn shapes Office stores . Pictures decoded, EMF GIF, drawn empty gray frame. Equations (Office Math text) drawn fractions, scripts, roots, sums, integrals, brackets accents. Arcs, underlines strike-ignored.

title: easeling 0.3.0
text: easel_xml() renders plotting code straight DrawingML string file involved; easel_dev(file=) remains file-based device. easel_size() easel_dev(dims =, wb =) size device real workbook cell geometry. Optional real font metrics ‘systemfonts’ (metrics =), built-table user-supplied tables alternatives. Text placement calibrated Excel’s line layout (text_voff), per-character vertical metrics correct centring. Shaped clip paths (R >= 4.1): exact arbitrary simple regions (Greiner-Hormann polygon intersection); multi-ring oversized regions fall back bounding box warning. Hard-edged alpha luminance masks render clips; soft inverse masks warn draw unmasked (representable DrawingML). Linear radial gradient fills, including radial focus position. Glyph API support (R >= 4.3, e.g. ‘marquee’ typeset text) via optional ‘systemfonts’ glyph--character mapping. Exact custDash patterns line types; evenodd paths keep holes; runs R >= 3.6 newer graphics API behind version guards.
